subject: Urgent: candidate visa appointment clash — recovery options and coverage
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@outlook.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Oct 2028 23:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Software Engineer interview (Tue 10/31)

Hi Marissa / Vivek —

I'm really sorry to do this at the last minute, but the visa application center just moved my biometric appointment to Tue morning (I only got the confirmation an hour ago). I won't be able to make the 10/31 9:00 AM PST technical screen.

I can do any of the following as alternatives:
- Tue 10/31 after 2:00 PM PST
- Wed 11/1 all day PST
- Take a recorded coding exercise or a take-home problem and upload by Thu EOD

If none of that works, I'll totally understand if the team needs to move forward — please let me know what you'd prefer. I can attach my appointment confirmation or passport scan if that helps with expense/visa paperwork.

Thanks for understanding — apologies again,
Asha Rao
(Phone: +91 98X-XXX-XXXX)

--
Asha Rao
MSc Computer Science, National University
Candidate for Software Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@outlook.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Software Engineer interview (Tue 10/31)

Hi Asha —

Thank you for the heads up and the context — totally understand. Could you please send over the appointment confirmation and a photo of your passport? We'll need those to process the travel/visa reimbursement (if applicable) and to document the schedule change. Attachments are fine.

Quick proposed recovery plan from our side (pick one):
1) Condensed live screen on Tue 10/31 at 3:30 PM PST (30 min coding + 15 min Q&A) — same interviewers if they are available.
2) Full tech screen on Wed 11/1 (your morning / our evening) — keep original agenda.
3) Take-home challenge: 48 hours to submit; follow-up 30-minute sync call for clarification and debrief.

Vivek / Grace — which of these options can you support? If we need immediate coverage, we can split the panel (one interviewer for system design, one for coding) to keep the process moving.

Asha — if you can, attach passport_scan.pdf and the appointment confirmation and I'll loop in Recruiting Ops for reimbursements.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 08:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Software Engineer interview (Tue 10/31)

Marissa — thanks for the options.

Prefer combo: offer Asha the condensed live screen Tues 3:30 PM PST (option 1) and the take-home fallback (option 3) if she can't do the live. If she goes live, we'll still ask for the take-home as a tie-breaker only if interviewers request more evidence.

Operational asks:
- Grace, can you confirm availability for Tue 3:30 PM PST (you + one other interviewer)? If not, we'll split (Grace covers system design; I'll cover coding).
- Marissa, please collect the passport_scan.pdf and appointment confirmation and forward to Recruiting Ops (reimbursements@redwood.ai) with the HubSpot link — include the HubSpot contact id in the note.
- If candidate uploads passport/receipt, add to the candidate's Drive folder and tag hiring_ops.

We should also be explicit about the time zone confusion for the candidate; offer a calendar invite with both local times. If Asha prefers to avoid live, default to the take-home + short follow-up.

I'll be on standby at 3:00 PM PST to step in if needed.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Staff Eng (Hiring Lead), Redwood Inference
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@outlook.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Software Engineer interview (Tue 10/31)

Hi all —

Thanks, Marissa and Vivek. I can do the condensed live screen on Tue 10/31 at 3:30 PM PST — please send the calendar invite with both IST and PST times. I attached my passport scan and the appointment confirmation PDF (passport_scan.pdf, appointment_confirm.pdf).

If something else shifts at the visa center, I prefer the take-home fallback (I can deliver within 48 hours).

Appreciate your flexibility and sorry again for the last-minute change.

Best,
Asha

Attachments: passport_scan.pdf, appointment_confirm.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@outlook.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Recruiting Ops <reimbursements@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: condensed live screen scheduled + instructions

Thanks Asha — invite sent (interview-invite.ics attached).

Summary of plan:
- Live: Tue 10/31 at 3:30 PM PST (03:30 PM PDT) — 30 min coding with Vivek, 15 min Q&A with Grace.
- Fallback: take-home coding task (48 hours) if the visa center changes the appointment.
- Recruiting Ops (reimbursements@redwood.ai) — received passport_scan.pdf and appointment_confirm.pdf; will process travel/visa reimbursement per policy. HubSpot ref: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/contact/ASHA-RAO-9382

Asha — please join the invite ~5 minutes early and use the Zoom link in the calendar; we'll record only with your permission. If you can't make it live, send a note here and we'll switch to the take-home task.

Thanks everyone — Grace, Vivek — see you at 3:30 PM.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
